body.p: This Purchase Order is Buyer's offer to buy the goods and services described in it on these terms. Seller accepts by signing and returning it, by acknowledging it, or by starting performance. Additional or different terms in Seller's quotation or acknowledgment apply only if Buyer agrees to them in writing, and terms the parties have agreed in a signed master agreement prevail over both.

then.p: This Purchase Order is issued under the {{master_ref}} between the parties (the "Agreement") and is subject to it. It specifies only the products, quantities, prices consistent with the Agreement, delivery dates and locations, and any other term printed on or referenced by it or by an acknowledgment has no effect. If it conflicts with the Agreement, the Agreement governs unless this Purchase Order expressly identifies the section it modifies and is signed by authorized representatives of both parties.
Because delivery is DDP, the Agreement's terms on import duties and customs clearance apply to this order.
No master agreement applies to this order. These terms, with the order lines above, are the entire agreement of the parties for it.

body.p: Prices are as stated in this Purchase Order and are firm for the order, excluding sales tax or VAT, which Seller itemizes. Freight is charged only if the order says so. Seller's invoice must reference the Purchase Order number and line items; Buyer pays undisputed amounts {{payment_terms}} after receiving a correct invoice, and tells Seller of any discrepancy within 10 business days of receipt.
Seller remit-to email for invoices: [[email:Seller:Remit-to email]]

Buyer may change quantities, delivery dates or specifications by written change order. If a change affects Seller's cost or schedule, Seller tells Buyer within 10 business days and the parties agree an equitable adjustment before Seller proceeds. Buyer may cancel all or part of the order for convenience before shipment, and pays Seller the order price for finished goods and Seller's documented cost, which Seller must mitigate, for work in progress and non-cancellable material bought for the order.

Buyer may inspect goods within 30 days after delivery and reject any that don't conform to this Purchase Order by written notice stating the nonconformity. Seller may, at its option and cost, repair or replace rejected goods within 15 days or refund their price. Goods not rejected within the inspection period are accepted, without affecting Buyer's warranty rights for defects that inspection wouldn't reasonably reveal.

Seller warrants that, for 12 months after acceptance, the goods will conform to this Purchase Order and their specifications, be free from defects in materials and workmanship, be new, and be delivered with good title, free of liens. Seller shall repair, replace or refund nonconforming goods at its cost, including return freight.

body.h: 7. Delivery, Title and Risk of Loss

body.p: Goods are delivered {{incoterm}} (Incoterms 2020). Title and risk of loss pass to Buyer on delivery in accordance with that term.

Seller shall defend and indemnify Buyer against third-party claims arising from the goods' infringement of intellectual property, from defects in the goods, or from Seller's negligence or willful misconduct, including claims for bodily injury or property damage.

Seller shall comply with all applicable laws, including anti-bribery laws such as the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and the UK Bribery Act 2010, export control and sanctions laws, and Buyer's Supplier Code of Conduct, and shall not offer or give anything of value to improperly influence any person.

then.p: This Purchase Order is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or relating to this Purchase Order by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days. A dispute not resolved in that time shall be finally settled by binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules, before a single arbitrator, seated in San Francisco, California, and judgment on the award may be entered in any court of competent jurisdiction. Either party may seek injunctive relief from a court to protect its confidential information or intellectual property.

This Purchase Order, and any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with it, is governed by the law of England and Wales. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Purchase Order by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days. A dispute not resolved in that time shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules, which are incorporated by reference into this section, before a sole arbitrator, with the seat of arbitration in London and English as the language of the arbitration. Either party may seek urgent injunctive relief from a court.

This Purchase Order, and any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with it, is governed by the laws of Ireland. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Purchase Order by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days, after which the courts of Ireland have exclusive jurisdiction to settle it.

body.p: If any provision of this Purchase Order is held invalid or unenforceable, it is enforced to the maximum extent permitted and the rest of this Purchase Order continues in full force. No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of it, and a waiver is effective only if it is in writing and signed. No person other than the parties and their permitted successors and assigns has any right to enforce any term of this Purchase Order. This Purchase Order may be signed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original and all of which together are one instrument.
